Artist Studio is a local creative suite for drawing, SVG animation, procedural painting, frame-by-frame animation, 2D characters, 3D reference, and phone shortcut decks.

Choose the installer for your OS and CPU. These builds bundle the backend runtime; Node.js and system Python are unnecessary. Use SHA256SUMS.txt to verify downloaded files.

These preparation builds are unsigned until signing is configured. Review installation, backups, tool limitations, and testing documentation in the repository before publishing this draft. TapPilot currently requires a trusted private LAN and has no pairing authentication. Anime 3D is an early studio.
